statement: Linux xpad's vendor-specific USB driver and SDL's native Xbox360 HIDAPI decoder are independent consumer routes; generic standard-HID UHID does not automatically bind xpad, and native USB endpoint arbitration without xpad has not been measured.

applicability.revision: Linux 4056b3c and SDL 535d80b; hardware/client build not measured
applicability.scope: xpad.c 118-132/477-503; SDL_xbox360.c 62-95. No evidence of selected Steam backend or physical arbitration.
